about.title: About
bio: As a software engineer, I have spent over nine years supporting product teams across the full application lifecycle, from full stack development to test automation.
Reliability is my playing field. I cut test campaign duration by more than 50% by industrialising Selenium and Cypress frameworks, then wiring those suites into continuous integration pipelines.
Day to day: JavaScript, React, Python and PHP, in Scrum as well as Kanban, with one obsession — shipping code the next team can pick up painlessly.
